Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Johannes Walch wrote:

> Johannes Walch wrote:
>
>> Just to make sure: As long as I control Mata Hari I cannot discard any
>> Burn Option cards during the untap phases. Right?

Assuming she's ready ... no. You can still discard one burn-option card
for which you do not control a minion that meets the requirements.

Mata doesn't meet the requirement for, say, The Slaughterhouse. You
may play it "as if" she does, however.

> And for even more personal clarification: Mata Hari allows me to play
> Tabriz Assembly but I cannot gain blood because Tabriz Assembly reads "a
> True Brujah you control gets one blood". Correct?

Mata cannot gain a blood from it, since she is not a Trujah.
A Trujah you control may gain a blood, though, even if the Assembly
was played using Mata's special.
